findings.evidence: The only repository use is `UniversalProperty.lean:119`. The reverse inclusion follows from `locSubring_mono P s S (Finset.subset_insert t U)` for the old subring and `divBy_mem_locSubring P (insert t U) s S (Finset.mem_insert_self t U)` for the new generator, followed by `Subring.closure_le`.
findings.fix: Replace it with an equality theorem (and orient/annotate it as an appropriate normal-form lemma), then derive the needed inclusion from that equality; alternatively keep this one-sided helper private if no public insertion API is intended.
findings.issue: `locSubring_insert_le` publicly exposes only one inclusion; in fact the displayed closure equals `locSubring P (insert t U) s S`, so consumers lack the characteristic insertion equation.

summary: The new public insertion API exposes only a weak containment although the exact interaction with `insert` is available.
